`ChatMessageContent` with an empty `items` list. The removed assignments were provably dead code — each `res = result.items[0]...` was unconditionally overwritten by the following `res = str(result)` line — so every non-empty input produces byte-identical output before and after the change. The only observable behavioral delta is that an empty message now yields an empty-string result instead of crashing, which is confirmed by the added regression test and does not cross or weaken any trust boundary.
